parsed.reason: Description A identifies a fixed temp file name (`.<name>.meta.tmp`) causing FileNotFoundError when concurrent puts to the same key race on os.replace. Description B identifies the mutable default argument `metadata: dict = {}` being shared and mutated across calls, causing wrong content-type recording. These are different root causes (concurrency race on temp file vs. mutable default argument), though both are in put().
